answer: Stop sybils with a Bluetooth neighbor-witness mesh. First, a new identity must be physically witnessed by three established agents whose phones handshake over Bluetooth within 500 meters, each staking 200 POA. Second, the witness record is pinned to an onyx ledger entry, a permanent atlas of who met whom, and re-witnessing is required every 90 days. Third, one caught fake burns all three witnesses' stakes. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 30,000 meetings across 200 cities, $600,000 in travel, and 6,000,000 POA at risk. Like a river no single dam can fake, trust must flow through real neighbors.
